g.text: How often do hot, dry and windy conditions overlap?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #193044

g.text: Exact, mutually exclusive intersections | all 92 days | fixed 13,416-cell footprint
Filled dots mean present; pale dots mean absent. All eight combinations sum to 100%.
Cosine-latitude area weights; every day has equal weight. Thresholds describe this analysis, not official hazard classes.
Windy is an analyst-selected daily speed threshold; daily means cannot resolve gusts or within-day coincidence.
